high_level_description: This image depicts the Orbiting Astronomical Observatory 2 (OAO-2), also known as "Stargazer," at NASA's Kennedy Space Center prior to its launch on December 7, 1968. The setting is an indoor facility, likely a clean room or a testing area within the space center, characterized by large windows with a grid pattern that allow natural light to enter. The OAO-2 is a large, complex spacecraft with a cylindrical body and several rectangular solar panels extending from it.
